Perpignan

elements.title: Off the Beaten Path (Wikivoyage recommendations)

Off the Beaten Path

Erice

Floating above the clouds on Sicily’s western coast, Erice has been a place of pilgrimage for millennia — from an ancient Temple of Venus to the medieval churches that remain open today.

elements.title: Featured Travel Topic (Wikivoyage recommendations)

Featured Travel Topic

Seminole Wars

A result of American settlement in the contested forests and prairies of colonial Florida, the devastating Seminole Wars fought between U.S. forces and Seminoles in Florida left behind wartime artifacts, forts, and plantation ruins from the 19th century.
